data.title: Coupang Forms External Security Advisory Committee After Massive Data Breach
data.description: According to The Korea Herald, Coupang has formed an external information security advisory committee as it works to rebuild public trust and strengthen defenses after last year’s data breach that affected more than 33 million users. The newly launched committee is meant to provide objective reviews of the company’s internal security policies and help improve safeguards for customer information. Coupang said seven outside professionals with expertise in information security, law and management will serve on the committee.

data.title: GEOPOLITICS | European Investment Bank Makes €40 Million Finnish Small Modular Reactor Investment
data.description:
The European Investment Bank is investing €40 million ($46 million) in Finnish small modular reactor start-up Steady Energy, according to Bloomberg.

The deal ends the lender’s four-decade break from nuclear financing as Europe pushes to develop new clean energy technologies.

data.title: Goldman, Templeton, Fidelity to Anchor NSE IPO
data.description:
Goldman Sachs Asset Management, Franklin Templeton and Fidelity International Ltd. are among the first global investors set to participate as anchor investors in National Stock Exchange of India Ltd.'s initial public offering, according to Bloomberg.

The exchange is preparing to raise as much as 226 billion rupees ($2.4 billion).

data.title: Ethereum Safe Wallet Attack Drains About $7.73 Million in rsETH
data.description:
A previously unknown Ethereum user’s Safe wallet was attacked, resulting in the loss of about $7.73 million in rsETH. According to Foresight News, Blockaid said the attacker used a public keeper multicall to redirect a custom Uniswap V4 LP Safe module to an attacker-created Hook liquidity pool.

The Hook then unwrapped aEthrsETH into rsETH, which was extracted by Yoink MEV in the same block.

data.title: Attacker Uses Custom Uni V4 LP Safe Module to Drain About $7.73 Million in rsETH
data.description: An attacker used a public keeper multicall to introduce a custom Uni V4 LP Safe module into a hook-based liquidity pool they created, then had the hook unwrap aEthrsETH into rsETH before Yoink MEV completed the extraction within the block. According to Odaily, the two transactions caused about $7.73 million in rsETH losses.

data.title: AI TRENDS | 0x Says Only 19.4% of Uniswap v4 Hooks Are Safe
data.description:
Crypto infrastructure firm 0x said after analyzing more than 84,000 Uniswap v4 Hooks that only about 19.4% could be considered safe, while 54.2% were classified as malicious and 26.4% as suspiciously malicious. According to Foresight News, it also said malicious Hooks do not need a separate interface and can be routed if their quotes appear best.

Uniswap founder Hayden Adams responded that the issue is technical and said users should not route to malicious Hooks. He said he can help teams facing the issue and stressed that v4 Hooks bring significant innovation. Adams also said the Uniswap developer API can provide better market prices, avoid malicious Hooks, access all Uniswap liquidity without fees, and support cross-chain use as well as integration with external liquidity as an aggregator.

data.title: Saudi Arabia Issues Alert in AlUla, Then Says Danger Has Passed
data.description:
Saudi Arabia's civil defense department issued an alert on Tuesday morning in AlUla, warning of a potential threat before later saying the danger had been lifted. According to Sina Finance, the alert covered AlUla, Jeddah, Yanbu, Abha, Jazan, and Taif.

The AlUla alert was the first of its kind there this year since the outbreak of the U.S.-Israel conflict with Iran. Saudi Arabia's civil defense department said the substantive threat behind the alert had eased, but it urged residents and visitors to remain vigilant, follow official safety guidance, and avoid gathering or taking photos in dangerous areas.

data.title: Investor Turns $8,300 Into Nearly $200,000 on ANSEM After June Purchases
data.description: A user identified as @2007sng bought ANSEM in 12 transactions at the end of June, spending about $8,300 in total when the token's market value was $1.5 million. According to Odaily, ANSEM's market value is now $147.8 million, and the user has cashed out $88,500 while still holding ANSEM worth $119,800, for a profit of $199,900 and a return of about 25 times.

data.title: Moody’s to Take Minority Stake in Philippine Rating Firm
data.description: Moody’s Corp. has agreed to acquire a minority stake in Philippine Rating Services Corp. as it seeks to tap debt-market growth in the Philippines and across Southeast Asia, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: Binance Wallet Adds Predictdotfun Prediction Markets Integration and Referral Features
data.description: Binance Wallet announced on X that users can now access Prediction Markets features through the @Predictdotfun integration on Binance Wallet. The update also allows users to activate prediction referrals through the Predict dApp, where referrers can earn a 10% commission and referees receive 5% off. The referral program is activated through Predict dApp, then Portfolio, then Referral, and then Activate Referral Program. Binance Wallet also summarized features already available on the platform, including Wallet Referral, which lets users earn up to 80% of friends' trading fees while friends receive 10% to 30% off, and Alpha Points, which can be earned for early airdrops and TGEs. The announcement did not provide additional details beyond the listed features and referral terms.

data.title: Binance Wallet Issues General Notice on Prediction Markets Access and Risk Disclosures
data.description:
Binance Wallet announced on X that its products and services may be restricted in certain regions. The announcement said the campaign and related products are not available to residents of the UAE, UK, EU, US, SG, HK, or other restricted jurisdictions, and that access is limited for users in those regions. It also stated that the notice is a general announcement and does not constitute financial or investment advice. The message added that participation involves significant risk, including the loss of capital.

The announcement also included a disclaimer about Prediction Markets. Binance Wallet said Prediction Markets are not provided by Binance ADGM entities and can only be accessed if a user holds a Binance Wallet. It said Binance Wallet Services are provided by Binance Barbados Limited and are not under the supervision of the Financial Services Regulatory Authority or any other regulatory authority. Binance Wallet also said it does not sponsor, endorse, or guarantee third-party services. In addition, the notice stated that Binance does not act as the counterparty in any investments made through the Prediction Markets feature. The announcement said use of the feature involves significant risk, including financial risk, market volatility, regulatory risk, and third-party risks, and that users may lose part or all of what they have invested.

data.title: GEOPOLITICS | PBOC Lifts Yuan Fix for Fifth Straight Day Before Trump-Xi Summit
data.description:
China’s central bank strengthened the yuan’s reference rate for a fifth straight day ahead of President Xi Jinping’s summit with US President Donald Trump later this month, according to Bloomberg.

The move was aimed at offsetting the dollar’s recent gains.

data.title: STOCKS | Hong Kong Half-Day Short Selling Reaches HK$18.35 Billion
data.description:
Hong Kong's half-day short selling turnover totaled HK$18.35 billion, accounting for 19.06% of market turnover of HK$96.248 billion, with 795 stocks sold short, according to ETNet.

Tracker Fund of Hong Kong (02800) and Southern Hang Seng TECH ETF (03033) were the most shorted names, with HK$2.156 billion and HK$1.217 billion respectively, representing 11.75% and 6.63% of total short selling. Their short sales accounted for 40.64% and 24.29% of each stock's turnover.

XL2 Southern Hynix (07709) and Hang Seng China Enterprises Index (02828) recorded short sales of HK$991 million and HK$762 million, equal to 5.4% and 4.15% of the total. Their short sales made up 65.79% and 44.74% of each stock's turnover. Tracker Fund of Hong Kong closed at HK$25.50, down HK$0.06 or 0.23%; Southern Hang Seng TECH ETF ended at HK$4.268, up HK$0.032 or 0.76%; XL2 Southern Hynix rose HK$0.36 or 0.97% to HK$37.38; and Hang Seng China Enterprises Index fell HK$0.22 or 0.26% to HK$85.44.
